svg.title: The agent loop: one round, and how a run leaves it
svg.desc: A round has four steps: the model call (1), the tool calls it asked for (2), their results (3), and fitting the prompt to the window (4); then the next round starts. A model call that fails before any output goes to Retry and back. The loop ends with a final answer when a round has no tool calls, with a final report at the round cap, or with an error when the retries are used up.

g.text: A round had no tool calls
